name: Netflix
summary: A dark streaming style with pure black canvas, disciplined red CTAs, high-contrast white typography, poster-heavy content shelves, and blue-purple gradient feature cards.

netflixRed.role: Logo, primary CTAs, active indicators, urgent interaction

featureCardBase.role: Token base for gradient feature cards

featureCardGradient.role: Feature card background and depth cue

chalkWhite.role: Primary headings, body text, and icon fills

components.hero: Full-bleed black hero with dimmed poster collage, centered 56px white headline, email input, and red CTA.
components.heroCta: Red filled action button with white 24px bold label and 4px radius.
components.headerSignIn: Compact red filled sign-in button with 14px label and 4px radius.
components.languageButton: Translucent black utility button with ash border and white text.
components.emailInput: Translucent dark input with slate border, white text, ash placeholder, and 4px radius.
components.trendingPosterCard: Vertical poster card with oversized 100px ranking numeral at the lower-left.
components.featureCard: 16px rounded card with deep blue-purple gradient, 24px padding, white heading and body.
components.footerLink: Silver 14px tertiary link without underline by default.

dos: Use pure black for main page backgrounds.
Reserve Netflix Red for logo, primary CTAs, and active states.
Use one sans type family throughout.
Use carousels and card grids as the core discovery pattern.
Use gradient feature cards for depth instead of shadows.
donts: Do not use any saturated accent besides Netflix Red.
Do not apply traditional box shadows.
Do not use light or gray page backgrounds.
Do not clutter the header with navigation.
Do not introduce complex shapes or playful rounding.
